author: S.F.Baird, 1869

months.note: 8월 중순~9월 상순에 남쪽으로 지나가는 개체가 주로 보인다.

summary: 늦여름에서 초가을 사이 우리 바다를 지나가는 나그네새로, 해마다 수십 마리가 섬을 오가는 배 위나 바닷가 곶에서 관찰된다. 제비갈매기 무리에 섞여 남쪽으로 날아가는 일이 많고, 바다에 뜬 부표나 표류물에 내려앉기도 한다. 수면 가까이 낮게 날거나 정지비행하다가 수면을 스치듯 내려 작은 새우 같은 갑각류와 작은 물고기를 잡는다. 사할린·캄차카·알래스카 등 베링해 둘레의 바닷가에서 번식하고, 겨울은 필리핀·인도네시아 부근의 적도 바다에서 나는 것으로 알려져 있다.

points.en: white forehead below a black crown, nape and lores (breeding)
grey underparts contrasting with white cheeks (breeding)
white rump and forked white tail
dark bar on the tips of the secondaries on the underwing

young: 어린새는 등·어깨·셋째날개깃이 어두운 회갈색에 흰 가장자리가 있어 비늘무늬를 이루고 아랫면은 희며, 날 때 어두운 등과 옅은 날개깃이 대비된다.

similar.how: 알류샨제비갈매기는 부리가 늘 검고 아랫면이 더 짙은 회색이며, 날개 아랫면 둘째날개깃 끝에 어두운 띠가 있어 제비갈매기와 다르다.

art.subject: Aleutian Tern (Onychoprion aleuticus), adult in breeding plumage, as seen at sea off Korea on spring passage in May: black crown and nape with a sharply defined white forehead reaching back to just above the eye; a black line from the bill to the eye; white cheeks and throat; upperparts and wings medium grey; breast and belly grey, contrasting with the white cheeks; rump and deeply forked tail white, contrasting with the grey back. Bill black; dark eye; short black legs.
art.pose: flying low and buoyantly over the sea, head angled down looking for small fish
art.scene: open sea off the Korean south coast in May, calm blue-grey water under a bright sky; no people, buildings or text
views: adult breeding, side view perched on a floating log: white forehead below a black crown and nape, black lores, white cheeks and throat, slim black bill, mid-grey back and wings, grey breast and belly contrasting with the white cheeks, white forked tail, short black legs

adult breeding, in flight seen squarely from below: long narrow pointed wings spread straight out to the sides to their full span, angled at the wrist, whitish underwing with a dark bar on the tips of the secondaries and dark-tipped primaries, white cheeks, grey breast and belly, white forked tail, feet tucked against the belly

adult breeding, in flight seen squarely from above: long narrow pointed wings spread straight out to the sides to their full span, angled at the wrist, mid-grey upperwing and back, white rump and white forked tail, black crown with a white forehead
art.build: Medium-sized, slender tern, about the size of a Common Tern, with long, narrow, pointed wings and a deeply forked tail with long outer streamers. Bill black, slim, straight and pointed, about as long as the head. Legs very short, black. In flight the underwing shows a dark bar along the trailing edge of the secondaries and dark tips to the outer primaries; flight buoyant and low over the sea.
avoid: Do not paint the black cap reaching the bill; the forehead is white.
Do not paint a red or orange bill or legs (Common Tern); both are black.
Do not paint white underparts; the breast and belly are grey, contrasting with the white cheeks.
Do not paint a grey rump and tail; they are white.
Do not paint dark brown or blackish upperparts (Bridled Tern, Sooty Tern).
